purpose: Determine whether the masked HF_OIDC_RESOURCE resolves to an existing public Hugging Face user without retaining or revealing its value and without requesting OIDC or dataset access.

decision.user_exists_false: HF_OIDC_RESOURCE is not a valid existing Hugging Face username; correct the GitHub secret before any PRIVATE304 rerun.
decision.user_exists_true: The resource resolves to a real Hugging Face user; remaining invalid_grant cause is the account CI/CD identity configuration or another account-level grant condition.
